descriptions.w3d_worm_pot_construct: Constructs a worm pot service with zeroed state and the observed vtable.
descriptions.w3d_worm_pot_dispatch: Initializes the worm pot after a successful type-64 base message.
descriptions.w3d_worm_pot_set_second_text: Sets text on the second linked object.
descriptions.w3d_worm_pot_apply_message: Applies a message value and forwards the message to both linked objects.
descriptions.w3d_worm_pot_apply_pair: Applies the respective messages to the two linked objects.
descriptions.w3d_worm_pot_update_text: Displays an empty string or the formatted current value on the first linked object.
